text:
anika: Following up on the authz postmortem — pattern still shows up in our telemetry: missing audit annotation + a tiny set of long-lived service tokens. Starting this thread to capture concrete owners, short deadlines, and a simple recurrence metric.

rob: Agreed. Can we keep remediation lightweight: emergency sweep + infra gate + CI lint?

anika: Proposed split: 
  - emergency sweep (safety-first rotator) -> owner @rob -> dry-run tonight, staged deploy tomorrow AM.
  - infra "policy gate" to block manifests without `audit/log:true` in prod -> owner @kevin -> PR by Tue.
  - CI linter + regression test to fail on missing annotation -> owner @tara -> target Fri.
  - secrets-aging job + RFC for rotation windows -> owner @lucy -> draft in 2 weeks.

rob: I'll take the sweep. Plan: run a dry-run that reports candidates, then run with `--max-parallel=2` and `--dry-run=false` only after ops sign-off. Will include `--rollback-window=10m`.

kevin: For the gate I'll implement an admission policy that denies create/update if annotation missing. Will include a config flag to allow exception list. Need a list of legacy services to exclude. @rob can you share CSV of tokens?

rob: CSV uploaded: https://internal.redwood/data/service_tokens_snapshot_2024-06-20.csv. Command I used to produce it: `kubectl get secrets -A -l app.kubernetes.io/token -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}{"|"}{.metadata.annotations}{"\n"}{end}'`

tara: CI side: adding two checks — manifest-lint rule + integration test: call introspect endpoint, simulate rotation, assert tokens are invalidated gracefully. Will also add a flakiness threshold.

lucy: RFC will propose default 60/90 day rotation windows, emergency rotation criteria, and an audit cadence. I'll draft and loop Legal for retention windows.

sec-bot: security: Created ticket SEC-1219 "Policy gate + sweep-runner + secrets lifecycle" and linked incident-712. Priority: P2.

ops-bot: deploy: policy-gate canary scheduled to dev: 2024-07-28T01:00Z.

anika: Quick metrics to track recurrence: `audit_hook_coverage_pct` and `rotator_candidates_count`. Closing criteria: >95% coverage for 2w and rotator candidates < 3/week.

rob: PR opened for sweep-runner: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/sweep-runner/pull/3. It supports `--dry-run`, `--max-parallel`, `--introspect-timeout`. Requesting review from @tara and @kevin.

kevin: Draft PR for admission policy: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/342. Notes: allowlist via `infra.redwood/exception=true`. Will add docs and a migration script.

tara: CI PR posted: https://git.internal/redwood/ci/linters/pull/56. Adds manifest rule `audit/log:true` and an integration test harness.

anika: Ops fallback: if sweep causes failures, run manual rotate steps in runbook and page oncall SRE. @rob can you add a quick checklist to the runbook?

rob: Done: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/emergency-token-rotate.md#checklist. Includes dry-run verification, `--max-parallel` change, and rollback contact list.

lucy: RFC draft: https://docs.redwood/rfcs/secret-aging-2024.md. Feedback welcome.

anika: Scheduling a 30m sync Thu 09:00 PT to verify PRs and runbook. If blocked, post updates here before 08:30 PT.

kevin: One ask: rotator should tag rotated tokens in telemetry with `rotation.initiator` so we can trace who/what triggered it. Will that be straightforward?

rob: Yes — adding `rotation.initiator` and `rotation.mode` tags. Also will emit `rotation.dry_run=true` events.

tara: Also adding an automated smoke that runs the rotator in dry-run weekly to catch regressions.

anika: Thanks all. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for follow-ups until checklist is green. :thumbsup:
